name: n8n_db_role_20261106
comment: ANCHOR: N8N_DB_ROLE_20261106 — n8n program package 0.1e. n8n moves off its Postgres bootstrap superuser onto
n8n_app (LOGIN, no SUPERUSER/CREATEROLE/CREATEDB/REPLICATION/BYPASSRLS), which owns n8n's objects in public and
may connect only to database n8n. Only a SCRAM verifier crosses to psql, on stdin; --switch refuses before the
0.1a cutover or before the role is ready, and fails unless the active-workflow count holds and n8n connects as
n8n_app. Hermetic: a fake docker runner.
